summary.headline: Privi Q1 FY27 revenue rose 19.22% YoY to Rs 666 crore; consolidated EBITDA Rs 167.47 crore at 24.58% margin, PAT Rs 83.2 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported Q1 FY27 consolidated total income of Rs 681.42 crore (+20.01% YoY), EBITDA of Rs 167.47 crore (+18.73% YoY) at about 24.58% margin, and PAT of about Rs 83.2 crore versus Rs 61.46 crore a year earlier. Growth was attributed to volume, price and product mix. Phase-1 capacity expansion (48,000 to 54,000 MT) is slated to commercialise within about 15 days, while the Phase-2 completion timeline has slipped to September 2027 for the final 12,000 MT. Gross margin compression (about 650 bps YoY per an analyst) was explained as a base effect from low-cost raw materials in CY25 and a normalising RM/sales ratio of 52-55%.

financial_highlights.change: vs Rs 61.46 crore in Q1 FY26
vs ~51% in Q1 FY26 (~650 bps decline, not disputed by management)

segments.name: PRIGIV JV (with Givaudan)
segments.commentary: Revenue about Rs 18 crore in Q1 with EBITDA margin of about 14-15%; output sold exclusively to Givaudan. Additional equity of Rs 50 crore agreed for next expansion phase.

segments.name: Camphor
segments.commentary: Management says camphor is about 4-6% of revenue (figures given as 5-6% and 4-5%), made via CST route; not treated as a strategic product.

guidance_outlook: Rs 5,000 crore revenue and Rs 1,000 crore+ EBITDA target reiterated, over three to four years (about 2x); management said no change in guidance.
Chairman: targeting ~20% CAGR with similar EBITDA margins, benchmarked off prior-year numbers.
EBITDA margin expected around 24.6% to nearer 25% going forward; RM/sales guided at 52-54%.
New specialty and furfural-based (Maltol, Ethyl Maltol, Cyclopentanone, Musk T) plants mechanically complete by about mid-FY28 with contributions from H2 FY28.
Privi Speciality / Privi Fine Sciences / Privi Biotechnologies merger: scheme filed with NCLT; completion expected this financial year (by FY27 year-end).
capex_capacity: Phase-1: capacity from 48,000 to 54,000 MT of existing products, expected to commercialise in about 15 days from the call; earlier 6,000 MT tranche slipped from June 2026 to September 2026.
Phase-2: additional 12,000 MT (54,000 to 66,000 MT) to be completed by September 2027; Phase-2 has commenced.
Phase-3 (multi-specialty aroma) expected to start around end-2026 or early 2027; funding mainly internal accruals with bank borrowing as needed.
Capex outlook for FY27 and next two years: Rs 850-900 crore, covering Phase-2 and Phase-3.
Post-merger, about 6,000 MT of Privi Fine Sciences capacity to be added to Privi portfolio. Utilisation at around 90% of installed capacity.
Demonstration plant in Navi Mumbai for 2 TPD biomass processing; 12-15 months to build, then about a year of operation before a large-scale plant (outside the 5K/1K plan).
demand_pricing: Demand described as healthy across fragrance and flavour value chain despite global headwinds; customers diversifying supply chains.
Growth attributed to volume, price increases and product mix; no quarterly volume/realisation split given (to be disclosed annually).
Crude-based raw materials ~15-18% of purchases; alpha-pinene from GTO at historic highs, but CST purchases are back-to-back with customers.
Management claims Iran war and Hormuz freight impact limited; Red Sea freight impact seen as ongoing for years with no margin concern.
Maltol and Ethyl Maltol >95% manufactured in China; Privi targets about one-quarter of global opportunity, with Ethyl Maltol demand from Indian pharma importers.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin fall ~650 bps YoY to ~44.2% and what recovers in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO cited low-cost RM and high CY25 selling prices in the prior-year base; RM/sales guided at 52-55% on average. Management expects EBITDA margin near 24.6-25% via scale benefits and lower depreciation and interest.

qa_highlights.question: Phase-2 capacity date: June or September 2027?
qa_highlights.answer: Clarified: the 6,000 MT Phase-1 tranche moved from June 2026 to September 2026; the 12,000 MT Phase-2 balance completes by September 2027. Guidance unchanged.

qa_highlights.question: Revenue from PRIGIV and its EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: PRIGIV revenue about Rs 18 crore in Q1 with EBITDA margin of about 14-15%.

qa_highlights.question: Alpha-pinene price rise impact?
qa_highlights.answer: CST purchases are back-to-back with customers; balance GTO-based alpha-pinene is at historic highs and costs are being passed on. Future direction not predicted.

qa_highlights.question: Phase-2/3 funding and debt levels?
qa_highlights.answer: Primarily internal accruals, with bank borrowing as needed; debt/EBITDA and debt/equity to stay well below typical thresholds.

qa_highlights.question: Capex for this year and next two years, and new 5K/1K plan products?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex Rs 850-900 crore over this year and the next two. Furfural-based chemistry (about Rs 1,000 crore+ revenue), Musk T and about 10-11 specialty molecules; plants mechanically complete by mid-FY28.

risks_watch: Phase-1 and Phase-2 timelines have already slipped; Phase-2 completion now September 2027 versus earlier June 2027 reference in annual report.
Gross margin compression (~650 bps YoY) and raw material mix volatility, with management attributing to base effects.
Volatile alpha-pinene and GTO-based raw material costs; management admitted no visibility on prices.
Dependence on new product ramp (furfural chain, Maltol, Musk T) from H2 FY28 for the 5K/1K target.
Merger completion (NCLT approval) and strategic alliances not yet disclosed in detail.
Management declined to disclose product-level split and quarterly volume/price breakdown.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the 5K/1K roadmap and margins, but defensive on margin compression and reluctant on specifics (product mix, volume split, alliance scope, PRIGIV products). Timeline slippage was acknowledged for Phase-1 with reassurance that guidance is unchanged.
key_quotes: We delivered around 25% margins consistently now across the last nine quarters.
We are confident of achieving 20%, maintaining 20% CAGR with similar EBITDA margins.
So, we see that EBITDA of around 24.6% and more nearing to 25% is definitely on the cards going forward.
We will have strategic alliances, but not joint ventures.
The PRIGIV JV revenue generated was about Rs. 18 crores and EBITDA generated was about 14%-15%.
So, let us not get into nitty-gritties. But it is an all-round growth overall.
